about: Roadside assistance for SLATE: what the motoring clubs charge and cover, what a tow costs without one, and how often a car calls for help. Read 2026-10-02. Prices are in the local currency's major unit. Where a figure could not be read from the club or regulator itself, it is null with the reason, or carried from a secondary source and marked so.

memberships.enrollmentFeeNote: Shown on the join page as waived at the time of reading.
memberships.covers: No roadside assistance; discounts and travel benefits only.

memberships.pricePerMonthNote: The club's own magazine says Basic is 'as low as $4.30 per month' with a one-time $15 enrollment fee. The join page loads the actual dues by home ZIP code and was not readable (it sits behind a bot wall), so no annual figure for a New York or Connecticut ZIP was read. A secondary source quotes $79 a year for 'Classic/Basic' (gas-price-check.com / cartipsdaily.com via search), not verified.
memberships.covers: Towing up to 3 miles, battery service, flat tire service, fuel delivery, vehicle lockout up to $50.

memberships.pricePerYearNote: Dues load by ZIP code and could not be read. Secondary source quotes $117 a year, not verified.
memberships.covers: Towing up to 100 miles, battery, flat tire, fuel delivery, lockout up to $100, extrication with a second truck for up to an hour.

memberships.pricePerYearNote: The club's magazine says the highest level is 'never more than $14 a month'. Secondary source quotes $144 a year, not verified.
memberships.covers: Towing up to 100 miles, one tow a year up to 200 miles, lockout up to $150, home lockout up to $100, rental car, passport photos.

memberships.pricePerYearNote: Not published on the club's static pages (dues load by ZIP). $59 a year 'as of August 2026' is from a local guide, Conejo Valley Guide, not the club. Search snippets elsewhere gave $56 to $57 plus a $20 admission fee, which the club often waives.
memberships.covers: Four calls a year per cardholder. Towing up to 7 driving miles, battery jump start, flat tire, fuel, locksmith up to $60. New California members join at Classic and can upgrade after 90 days without a tow.

memberships.pricePerYearNote: Not published on the club's readable pages. The $99.99 that turns up in searches is AAA Mountain West Group (Northern California), a different club.
memberships.covers: Same four calls; towing up to 100 driving miles; locksmith up to $100; fuel delivered.

memberships.pricePerYearNote: Not published on the club's readable pages. Mountain West Group's $124.99 is a different club.
memberships.covers: One tow a year up to 200 driving miles, the rest up to 100; locksmith up to $150; home lockout up to $100 (Southern California residence only); one-day rental car with a tow.

memberships.taxNote: The comparison page does not say whether HST is included.
memberships.covers: Bike assist only (one call, 10 km).
Battery service, lockout, fuel delivery (member pays for the fuel), tire service, bike and motorcycle assist; tow up to 10 km.
Tow up to 200 km, fuel delivered free, battery, lockout, tire, rental car benefit.
Five calls: one tow up to 320 km and four up to 200 km; fuel, battery, lockout, tire, rental car.
Roadside on demand for a fee; needs an upgrade fee for immediate roadside access.
Fuel delivery, locksmith, battery service, tow up to 5 km, EV depleted-battery tow. Full access 72 hours after purchase.
As Basic, tow up to 160 km.
Four calls: one tow up to 320 km and three up to 160 km.

memberships.priceNote: 'From £5.49 a month', the price at least 10% of customers paid for monthly vehicle Roadside Assistance, June to August 2026. Levels are priced by quote only. A broker guide (Rooster) gives 'around £76.28 a year' for new-customer basic roadside cover, not verified against the AA.
memberships.taxNote: UK consumer prices are quoted inclusive of insurance premium tax.
memberships.callsNote: 'Unlimited call-outs, subject to policy terms', for breakdowns more than a quarter mile from home.
memberships.covers: Roadside repair or a tow to a nearby garage. Add-ons: At Home (within 1/4 mile of home), National Recovery (any single UK destination), Onward Travel, Parts and Garage Cover (up to £535 a claim, £35 excess), Tyre Cover (up to £160 a tyre).
24/7 roadside assistance. The page's comparison ticks were not reliably read, so which extras (national recovery, home cover) Basic includes is unconfirmed.
memberships.priceNote: 'From' prices: at least 10% of new customers paid this for single-vehicle cover.

memberships.covers: Roadside; national recovery anywhere in the UK if not fixed (starts 24 hours after joining); home cover.
As Standard with unlimited call-outs.
As Extra plus EV cover.

memberships.priceNote: 'From €5/Month' paid annually; priced by the car's make, model and age, by quote only. An independent guide (odo.ie, April 2026) estimates Rescue ~€115-125, Rescue Plus ~€155-170 and Rescue Plus Recovery ~€210-230 a year; these are its estimates, not AA prices.
memberships.covers: Roadside rescue (80% repaired at the roadside), Home Start, cover for the person in any car. Rescue Plus adds towing and alternative transport, limited to three call-outs.

memberships.club: A.N.A. Compañía de Seguros (bundled with car insurance)
memberships.priceNote: Not sold on its own: it is a coverage inside the car policy, and the policy is priced by quote. Mexico has no motoring club equivalent to AAA in reach of this research.
memberships.callsNote: 'Ilimitados durante cada anualidad' (unlimited each policy year) under the Km 0 coverage; the same services under the habitual-driver Extensión de Coberturas are limited to 2 events a policy year.
memberships.towNote: Tow to the nearest workshop agreed with the driver, or home. Applies from the place of residence up to 100 km from it; beyond 100 km the Asistencia en Viajes coverage tows to the nearest workshop.
memberships.covers: Tow, fuel (up to 10 litres, paid by the insured), tire change, jump start, locksmith dispatch (key duplicate paid by the insured).

memberships.priceNote: Included in the car policy, not priced separately. Read from qualitasseguros.mx, which appears to be an agent's site rather than Quálitas's own (qualitas.com.mx).
memberships.covers: Tows 5 a year (Plus 10); jump starts 5; tire changes 5; fuel 2 a year with 5 litres free (Plus 5); locksmith per conditions (Plus 5). Limits vary with Básica, Limitada, Amplia or Plus cover.

towPrices.includedMiles: The first five to seven miles may be in the base fee.

towPrices.kind: regulated cap, nonconsensual tow (6 RCNY §2-368(c), under Admin Code §20-509)
towPrices.towFeeNote: Plus tolls. Applies to tows the owner didn't ask for (private property), not to a breakdown tow the driver calls; those are unregulated.

towPrices.kind: regulated, NYPD Rotation Tow Program (6 RCNY §2-372(t))
towPrices.storageNote: Up to 30 days. Vehicles registered at 10,000 lb or less pay $125; heavier $140.

towPrices.kind: regulated, arterial highway tow of a disabled passenger car (Admin Code §20-509.1)
towPrices.note: Read from the search engine's extract of the code; the code library returned 403 to a direct read. This is the cap that applies to a breakdown on a city arterial highway.

towPrices.kind: regulated, LAPD Official Police Garage rates, effective 2026-01-01
towPrices.mileageNote: The PDF's two columns were misaligned in extraction; $12 a mile is the most likely reading of 'Mileage Rate (per mile)' but should be checked. Applies to police-ordered tows; a breakdown tow the driver arranges is unregulated.

towPrices.kind: regulated, Connecticut DMV maximum nonconsensual private-property tow, effective 2026-01-01
towPrices.towFeeIncludes: Mileage to the scene and two loaded miles.

towPrices.kind: regulated, Connecticut DMV police-ordered tow (Public Act 25-55), under 10,000 lb
regulated, City of Toronto accident tow (Municipal Code ch. 545)
towPrices.towFeeNote: Set at $250 and indexed each year to Toronto CMA CPI; $261.38 was the 2020 rate. The current indexed rate was not found. Up to 3,175 kg GVWR.
towPrices.perKmNote: For each km beyond 5 km outside city limits.

towPrices.kind: Ontario TSSEA filed maximum rates, one operator's (Abrams Towing), effective 2025-12-01
towPrices.note: Ontario does not set a tow price: each operator files its own maximums with the MTO under the Towing and Storage Safety and Enforcement Act and may not charge above them. These are one Toronto operator's maxima for a basic tow up to 4,536 kg, not what it actually charges. Read from the PDF with misaligned columns.

towPrices.kind: ICBC towing rate payment schedule, light duty (0-2,999 kg)
towPrices.note: What ICBC, the province's insurer, pays tow operators on claims, including the first 6 km; T&R+ and Base are its two operator tiers. GST is paid on top by ICBC. The City of Vancouver ties its private-impoundment rates to ICBC's; its page and a 2026 council report (both 403 to a direct read) give $82.18 for a car, and search extracts give an ICBC update of 2025-12-15 at $82.18 / $71.70 and $2.48 / $2.44 a km. The PDF read may predate that update.

towPrices.kind: regulated, SCT maximum tariff for towing on federal roads, grúa tipo A
towPrices.note: Banderazo plus a per-km charge; published in the DOF 2017-02-21, effective 30 days later. Applies only on federal highways and bridges, not city streets. No indexation rule is stated, so 2026 charges may be higher. Fractions over 500 m count as a km.
A Mexico City roadside firm's own range. No official CDMX tariff for a driver-requested tow was found.

towPrices.kind: statutory police removal charge, England and Wales (SI 2023/331), from 2023-04-06
towPrices.note: A car up to 3.5 t, upright on the road and not substantially damaged. Storage is £26 per 24 hours (£13 for a two-wheeler). There is no regulated price for a breakdown recovery the driver calls.
Not found from a reliable source. Neither the AA nor the RAC publishes a join-at-the-roadside price; what turned up were recovery firms' own ranges (around £100-£400), not used here.

towPrices.typicalNote: A tow within about 10 km, which most firms include in the base rate.
towPrices.note: A Dublin tow firm's guide, published 2026-05-22. Ireland has no regulated tow price. odo.ie's estimates are higher: €150-€300 for roadside help and €250-€500+ for a flatbed.

breakdownRates.derivation: 27,000,000 calls / 58,000,000 US members. Per member, not per car: a household's members share cars and lockouts count as calls.
'Over three-million calls serviced across Canada, every year' / 'over six-million members'. Both are lower bounds from a marketing page; no year given.

3,500,000 / 14,000,000 roadside members. Business customers include fleets and cover sold with new cars; the AA doesn't split breakdowns between personal and business, so a personal rate can't be isolated.
2.4 million breakdowns (as cited by the AA from the RAC's 2025 annual report; the RAC's own release says 'more than two million') / 15.0 million members at H1 2025, most of them business members.

breakdownRates.note: 'A three-in-10 chance' a year that an SME's van or car breaks down, from Q1 2019 call-outs. The only figure found that is per vehicle rather than per member.

breakdownRates.derivation: 120,000 / 300,000. Both figures are from Wikipedia, flagged there as needing a citation, with no year. Weak.

breakdownRates.body: The AA Ireland, sample of 100,000 call-outs

breakdownRates.note: No published count of roadside call-outs against insured or member cars was found for Mexico.

notes: Where the clubs' own pages were readable, the figures are theirs. AAA Northeast and the Automobile Club of Southern California price by home ZIP code in script the reader couldn't run (AAA Northeast also blocks automated reads), so their annual dues are mostly null. Club benefits (tow distance, calls, lockout caps) are from their own pages and member guide.

The rates by member are calls per member a year, not per car. AAA counts lockouts and fuel among its calls, and the UK clubs' membership includes business and new-car cover. The nearest per-car figure is the RAC's 31% annual chance for business vehicles (2019). Rough rate of call-outs per covered member a year: US 0.47 (AAA 2024), Canada ~0.5 (CAA), UK 0.16-0.25 (RAC, AA), Ireland ~0.4 (weak).

Causes: the battery is first everywhere: AAA ~7M of 27M calls in 2024 (26%), with tows ~13M (48%); AA Ireland 25.8% battery, 13% tyre, 10.5% fuel, 5.8% locks/alarm; RAC business 18% battery, 13% tyres. AAA's 23.8% battery / 13.1% flat tire / 11.2% lockout split turned up in search extracts from AAA pages but its own page wasn't read, so it's left out of the data.

Regulated tow caps mostly cover tows the owner didn't ask for (police, private property, accidents), not the breakdown tow a driver calls, which in every market here is priced freely. The consumer guides are tow firms' or price sites' ranges, not regulator data.

Fit with repairs.ts: SLATE's severe RepairPal fault stops the car. A severe fault is the natural trigger for a tow, at the membership's tow distance or the local price; an ordinary fault, a flat battery or a flat tyre are the roadside-fix cases (both UK clubs and AA Ireland report about 80% fixed at the roadside).
